data.escalation_detail: S20-S24 are key invalid-evidence and wrong-route rejection paths; S25 is the low-coverage bounded-gap single-assessor path. These six uncovered scenarios are directly tied to the new acceptance gate, so the PM judged their evidence gap material rather than using a numeric threshold.
data.coverage_gap_reason: Six of 25 observable scenarios (S20-S25) lack behavior test evidence, including invalid policy, stale assessment revision, incomplete risk fields, material-gap misuse of single mode, missing complementary focus, and low-coverage bounded single mode.
data.rationale: The final authorized focused run passed eight black-box methods with zero product behavior assertion failures and 19/25 scenarios covered. Three independent assessors, assigned acceptance-impact, technical-repair, and delivery-operations, each voted accept-with-risk. The known evidence gaps remain explicit and go to independent Reviewer review.
data.exceptions: Accept S20-S25 as untested and business-code branch coverage as not measured for this handoff; do not count either as passed, and do not waive implementation requirements.
data.residual_risk: Invalid fields or policies may incorrectly pass or block a PM decision in six untested paths. Occurrence probability is unknown. Reviewer must inspect undisclosed implementation defects and evidence integrity.
